create_MotionData_transitive: create a transitive MotionData object from a fairmotion Motion for cyclical walk or run path traversal
create_MotionData_scenic: create a scenic MotionData object with a direction offset and transitive motion reference for performative actions
create_PathData: create a PathData object from a list of magnum Vector3 points to calculate total path length
create_ActionOrder: create an ActionOrder to command a character to perform a scenic motion at a specified location and facing direction
use_Timer: use the Timer class static methods start and check to measure elapsed time since the last start call
